data.name: Cathlene
data.gender_notes: Cathlene is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Greek name Katherina, meaning pure or clear. In Christian tradition, the name Catherine is associated with the saint and martyr Saint Catherine of Alexandria. She was a learned woman who converted many to Christianity and was known for her strength and courage in the face of persecution. The name Cathlene carries the meaning “Pure, Clear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cathlene usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes purity of heart and soul.
data.etymology: Cathlene belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Clear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cathlene total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Καθλήνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καθλήνη προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές και λατινικές λέξεις, που σημαίνει 'καθαρότητα και απλότητα' ή 'αγνότητα'. Είναι συνδεδεμένο με τις έννοιες της καθαρότητας και της απλότητας, και χρησιμεύει ως υπενθύμιση για την καθαρότητα της ψυχής και της καρδιάς.

in_latin.name: Cathlene
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Cathlene originates from Greek and Latin words, signifying 'purity and simplicity' or 'cleanliness'. It is connected to the concepts of purity and simplicity, serving as a reminder of the purity of soul and heart.

in_english.name: Cathlene
in_english.meaning: Purity and simplicity, a clean and uncomplicated form
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cathlene is derived from Greek and Latin roots, meaning 'purity and simplicity' or 'a clean and uncomplicated form'. It is associated with the biblical concepts of purity and innocence. Historically, the name has been used in Christian traditions to signify a pure and simple heart. The name Cathlene is not directly mentioned in the Bible but is related to the virtues emphasized in Christian teachings. It symbolizes a person of clear conscience and moral integrity.
